extracted.intended_audience: Brazilian researchers, research administrators, and applicants to CNPq funding and prizes
extracted.subtask_description: Announcements and briefings about CNPq funding calls, prizes, partnerships and institutional policies, including eligibility, deadlines, funding amounts, thematic priorities and program-specific rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding caps for 'Apoio a Eventos de Promoção do Empreendedorismo e da Inovação' call
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposals approved will be financed with a total of R$ 2,5 milhões from SETEC/MCTI and CNPq; each project will have a maximum value of R$ 200 mil for international events and R$ 150 mil for national events.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deadline for the first round of submissions: inscriptions open until 28/05. This establishes program-level budget ceilings and per-project maximums and distinguishes funding limits by event scope (international vs national).

rubrics_metrics.name: Thematic and budgetary conditions for call on alternatives to animal experimentation
rubrics_metrics.description: CNPq supports projects about alternative methods to animal experimentation in research; the call has a global value of R$ 50 milhões from the Fundo Nacional de Desenvolvimento Científico e Tecnológico.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deadline for submissions: until 03/07. Theme requirement (methods alternative to animal experimentation) is an explicit eligibility/priority criterion; total program budget is specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prêmio Jovem Cientista 2026 theme and category eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: The 2026 Young Scientist Prize theme is 'Inteligência artificial para o bem comum' and the edition will award categories: Mestre e Doutor, Estudante do Ensino Superior and Estudante de Ensino Médio.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inscrições (registrations) were prorogued to 14/08. Theme and categorical division set topical and applicant-type eligibility for submissions to the prize.

rubrics_metrics.name: Novo PCI call budget and regional allocation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: The new PCI call will invest R$ 120 milhões in research units linked to MCTI; at least 30% of the global investment will be destined to projects from the North, Northeast or Central-West regions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This creates an explicit geographic allocation/prioritization requirement within the call (minimum share for specified regions); deadline for submissions: until 27/05.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pesquisador(a) Emérito(a) recognition eligibility and benefits
rubrics_metrics.description: The title recognizes Brazilian scientists or foreigners resident in Brazil for at least ten years for their 'conjunto da obra' (body of work).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In addition to the diploma, honorees receive airline tickets and up to six daily allowances for participation in a scientific congress in Brazil or abroad. The criterion emphasizes long-term residence and overall career contribution rather than a single work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Embrapa–CNPq agricultural training partnership target beneficiaries and modalities
rubrics_metrics.description: Partnership invests R$ 50 milhões in agricultural capacity-building for African countries, targeting training of technicians, extension agents and farmers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program modalities include distance education courses and in-person activities; the announcement describes target audiences and delivery formats as program requirements/expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: BRICS for Science calls: thematic eligibility and program structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Two calls under the BRICS framework invest R$ 15 milhões: a regular call for projects on water resources; high-performance computing and AI; energy; health; biotechnology and biomedicine; food and scientific materials; and a Flagship call involving digital earth initiatives; psychomolecular tools; intelligent telescope and data network.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The list of thematic areas defines eligible project topics for the respective calls and thus functions as a programmatic eligibility rubric.

rubrics_metrics.name: CNPq Policy of Integrity in Scientific Activity (Política de Integridade)
rubrics_metrics.description: Policy establishes norms and good practices of conduct in scientific activity, elaborated on the basis of education, prevention, investigation and sanction, and brings guidelines for the use of AI in scientific research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The policy sets institutional standards for research integrity, including processes for education, prevention, inquiry and disciplinary measures; it also provides explicit guidance on acceptable AI use in research contexts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adicional de Bancada allowable uses
rubrics_metrics.description: The 'Adicional de Bancada' details the monthly payment to fellows to cover costs of research activities and technological-scientific work such as acquisition of inputs and consumable materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This defines, at a program level, what bench/operational supplement funds may be spent on (supplies and consumables), specifying permissible expense categories for fellowship support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Call-level deadlines and rectifications as part of procedural requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Calls include explicit submission deadlines (e.g., 28/05, 03/07, 27/05, 16/06, 18/05, 14/08) and may receive retifications that alter the wording of items to clarify frequent doubts from the scientific community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deadlines are binding procedural eligibility constraints; retifications/errata are an established mechanism to clarify or change call rules, and applicants must track such amendments when preparing submissions.
